scenario.rotation: uniform sidereal about polar axis; epoch degenerate with body-fixed perilune longitude in this stage
scenario.truth_rule: N=600 if perilune < 50 km else N=300

comparator_rule.fixed_crit: empirical tail-criterion N_min at perilune altitude (rev4 convention, unquantized)
comparator_rule.fixed_work: nearest integer to sqrt(mean N^2) of the sched_emp run of the same orbit
